title: Doctrine fixtures manifest
description: Records provenance for every doctrine PDF used as a fixture in this repo. AGENTS.md Section 3: a file with no entry here, or a distributionStatement that isn't unlimited public release, must never be committed or synthesized.

$schema.description: Editor-tooling convenience pointer back to this schema file; not semantically meaningful.

title.description: The publication's full title, e.g. 'AFMAN 13-1AOC Volume 3, Air Operations Center'.

sourceUrl.description: Where the PDF was downloaded from.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the downloaded PDF file, so a re-download can be checked for drift.

publicationDate.description: The publication's own effective/publication date (ISO 8601 YYYY-MM-DD), not the download date.

distributionStatement.description: The exact distribution statement printed on the document. Only documents whose statement is an unlimited public-release statement may be committed or synthesized (AGENTS.md Section 3) — this field records the statement as printed; scripts/validate-fixtures.mjs additionally checks it reads as unlimited release.

localPath.description: Path to the PDF relative to fixtures/doctrine/. The PDF itself is gitignored; only this manifest is committed.

note.description: Free-text caveat, e.g. why a section is hard to cite, or an access issue encountered fetching it.
